# Locations & Battles

## Avenue {#avenue}

The Avenue is a four- or five-hundred-yard stretch of road near [Newbridge](../codex/places.md#newbridge) that is completely arched over by large apple trees planted by an old farmer.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P40](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0040), [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P41](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0041), [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P42](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0042), [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P43](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0043), +14 more_

## Avonlea {#avonlea}

Avonlea is the hometown of a group of young scholars who left to attend the Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P1](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P2](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P3](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P4](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0004), +42 more_

**Associated with:** [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Barbara Shaw](../character/barbara-shaw.md), [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md), [Lorenzo White](../character/lorenzo-white.md), [Major Spencer](../character/major-spencer.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Robert Bell](../character/robert-bell.md), [Stacy](../character/stacy.md)

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) continue canvassing Avonlea for subscriptions, encountering peculiar neighbors like the hyper-neat Mrs. Theodore White and receiving mixed results. Learning that [Lorenzo White](../character/lorenzo-white.md) just had a new baby boy, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) strategically visits him while he is overjoyed, securing a generous five-dollar donation. Later that evening, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) to ask for a contribution, but he flatly refuses.
>
> — v2 · VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P37](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0037), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P44](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0044), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P49](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0049), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P56](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0056)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) spends an evening with [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), who tearfully admits her fear of dying and leaving her life behind. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) offers comfort, but Ruby passes away peacefully in her sleep the following night. After the funeral, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflects deeply on life and mortality while walking home with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md).
>
> — v3 · Chapter XIV The Summons

_Sources: [v3 ch.Summons P7](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0007), [v3 ch.Summons P11](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0011), [v3 ch.Summons P30](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0030), [v3 ch.Summons P35](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0035)_

## Bailey {#bailey}

Located near [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley), the old Bailey place is a ruined, abandoned property with a dyke and garden that local residents rumor to be haunted by the ghost of a abused boy named [Henry Warren](../character/henry-warren.md).

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XXVIII. A FAST DAY P25](../source/v05-c28.md#nw-v05-c28-p0025), [v5 CHAPTER XXVIII. A FAST DAY P26](../source/v05-c28.md#nw-v05-c28-p0026), [v5 CHAPTER XXIX. ## Birch Path {#birch-path}

Named by [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), the Birch Path is a picturesque, narrow, and spicy-aired pathway fringed with young birches and wildflowers that winds through Mr. Bell's woods on the route to the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P70](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0070), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P0](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XV. > On her thirteenth birthday, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walks to school with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and discusses growing up, her creative story writing, and a new plan to form a story club with their friends. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) tells [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about the success and rules of the story club, though [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) remains skeptical of the endeavor.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed

## Bolingbroke {#bolingbroke}

Bolingbroke is a place in [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia) that is the birthplace of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and the home of [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md).

_Sources: [v3 ch.Lady P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028), [v3 ch.Lady P29](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0029), [v3 ch.Lady P30](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0030), [v3 ch.Lady P31](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0031), +15 more_

**Associated with:** [Alec](../character/alec.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Shirley](../character/shirley.md)

> During her stay in Bolingbroke with [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits her humble birthplace and meets the woman currently living there. The woman allows [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to explore the house, including the room where she was born, and hands over a small packet of old letters written by Anne's parents. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) later visits her parents' grave and reads the letters, feeling for the first time that she truly knows them.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXI Roses of Yesterday

_Sources: [v3 ch.Yesterday P4](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0004), [v3 ch.Yesterday P11](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0011), [v3 ch.Yesterday P15](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0015), [v3 ch.Yesterday P22](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0022)_

## Boston {#boston}

Boston is a noisy, crowded city where [Jordan](../character/jordan.md) Gray worked for a winter and [Hester](../character/hester-gray.md) Murray worked in a store prior to their marriage, and where [Jordan](../character/jordan.md) returned following her death.

_Sources: [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P47](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0047), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P48](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0048), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P49](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0049), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P50](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0050), +8 more_

**Associated with:** [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md)

## Bright River {#bright-river}

Bright River is a location reachable by an eight-mile drive from [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) Cuthbert's home, featuring a train station house with a long platform and ladies' waiting room, as well as a small local hotel.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P12](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0012), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P14](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P15](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0015), +26 more_

> [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) travels to Bright River station expecting to pick up an orphan boy, only to discover that a young girl has been left for him instead. Unable to tell the talkative child about the mistake, [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) takes her bag and offers her a ride to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) in his buggy. During the initial leg of the drive, the girl talks continuously about her vivid imagination and dramatic thoughts, while [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) finds himself surprisingly enjoying her conversation.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised

## East Grafton {#east-grafton}

East Grafton is a settlement home to a gravely ill distant relative of [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) named Mary, whose residents did not get along particularly well with her.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P12](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0012), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P13](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0013), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P14](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0014), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P15](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0015), +14 more_

## Echo Lodge {#echo-lodge}

Echo Lodge is a stone house inhabited by Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), which is scheduled to be boarded up and left empty during the winters while being used as a summer home following her marriage.

_Sources: [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P73](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0073), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P74](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0074), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P75](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0075), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P76](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0076), +15 more_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to teaching school, where [Dora](../character/dora.md) is frightened by [Mirabel](../character/mirabel-cotton.md) Cotton's stories about a ghost relative. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) walk through the woods to go to [West Grafton](../codex/places.md#west-grafton), but lose their way and discover Echo Lodge, the quaint stone home of Miss [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and her young helper, [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md). Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) warmly invites them to stay for a imaginary tea party she had set up to combat loneliness.
>
> — v2 · XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P53](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0053)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) share tea with Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and her maid [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md) at Echo Lodge, where Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) explains her imaginary party and the origin of her echoes. After [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) demonstrates the echoing tin horn and Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) explains her maid's given name, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) inadvertently mentions [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md). Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) briefly inquires about [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md) Irving's son before bidding the girls a wistful goodbye.
>
> — v2 · XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P62](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0062), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P71](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0071), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P81](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0081), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P87](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0087)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) at Echo Lodge on a wintry evening, and over tea and candy, Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) recounts her long-ago romance and quarrel with [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md). A month later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) introduces Stephen's son, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md), to Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), and the two immediately form a fond friendship during their visit.
>
> — v2 · XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance

_Sources: [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P4](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0004), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P10](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0010), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P17](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0017), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P26](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0026)_

> At [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) dresses in a new pale green dress and converses with [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and [Dora](../character/dora.md) before leaving for Echo Lodge. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) then walk to Echo Lodge, where they eat lunch and visit with Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md) in the garden. Afterward, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) plays with the echoes while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) set out to pick early strawberries for tea.

After Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) leaves in huff, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) confronts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) upstairs and orders her to remain in her room until she agrees to apologize.

Before leaving [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) faces mixed reviews about her published story and adopts a stray cat, [Rusty](../character/rusty.md), whom they fail to chloroform. Redmond College is a higher education institution that offers a four-year Arts course with subjects such as dead languages, geometry, English, Classics, and Mathematics, culminating in examinations, a [Convocation](../codex/places.md#convocation) ceremony with diploma conferral by a president, and a graduation dance.

## Thanksgiving {#thanksgiving}

Thanksgiving is a November holiday that [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) suggested sending a hamper for, though [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) felt it would be better celebrated in May when nature is alive.

During the drive to Janet's home, Mrs. [Skinner](../character/skinner.md) entertains [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with stories about her recent marriage and her romantic decisions.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXX Mrs. Skinner’s Romance

_Sources: [v3 ch.Romance P0](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0000), [v3 ch.Romance P3](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0003), [v3 ch.Romance P5](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0005), [v3 ch.Romance P15](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0015)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accompanies [Janet](../character/janet.md) to a prayer meeting in Valley Road, where she meets [John Douglas](../character/john-douglas.md), Janet's quiet admirer. The next day, John invites them both to his house for tea so [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) can meet his elderly mother. During the visit, Mrs. Douglas treats [Janet](../character/janet.md) politely while making light comments about her impending death and John's eventual marriage, leaving John looking visibly tortured.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXII Tea with Mrs. Douglas

_Sources: [v3 ch.Douglas P0](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0000), [v3 ch.Douglas P5](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0005), [v3 ch.Douglas P10](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0010), [v3 ch.Douglas P29](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0029)_

> During her time in Valley Road, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives an awkward proposal from [Sam](../character/sam.md), which she politely rejects and later laughs about with [Janet](../character/janet.md). After John Douglas's mother passes away, [Alec](../character/alec.md) fetches [Janet](../character/janet.md), and John soon arrives to propose to [Janet](../character/janet.md), explaining that his mother forced him to promise to wait until her death before marrying or telling anyone.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXIV John Douglas Speaks at Last
